profile.name: Product Lifecycle Lead
profile.description: Runs every product from launch to retirement: checks a new product is ready in every market before it goes live, scores how it does in its first 90 days, finds the products that only add clutter, and retires them without stranding a single autoship customer.

listing.pitch: Your head of product: launches products ready, judges them on real repeat buying, and retires the dead weight cleanly.
highlights: Checks prices, photos, text, volume and stock in every market before a launch
Scores each new product at 30, 60 and 90 days on reorders, not just launch sales
Finds products that sell little, have a better substitute and only add clutter
Plans each retirement: autoship customers, kits, bundles and remaining stock
Moves autoship customers to a replacement only with your approval
Keeps one product calendar so launches and retirements never collide
example_prompts: Is the new collagen blend ready to launch in every market?
How is last month's launch doing compared with our usual launch?
Which products should we think about retiring this quarter?
What breaks if we discontinue the travel-size lotion?
Move everyone on autoship for the old formula to the new one.
What's on the product calendar for the next 90 days?

suggested_triggers.label: Every weekday at 8am: launch and retirement check
Every Tuesday at 9am: weekly product review
On the 1st at 10am: monthly catalog review
